a468001b6df7: Export stories as PDF or Markdown · translationCore 4 Help
0f29d9d6694a: Export PDF: a reading copy for reviewers, with or without pictures.
9bf5238223e9: Story Markdown (.zip): the story files for other Open Bible Stories tools.
24350718eb1d: Scripture Burrito (.zip): the whole project. See Export a project as a Scripture Burrito.
ee25f850300e: Open a story and click Check, then Open → on Community Checking.
cd1b84c31406: Optional: choose the layout and pictures. See Story preview and export.
f882c57168b5: Click Export (1), then pick a format (2).
cbe483bf884a: Draft at least the title or one frame before you export a PDF.
c02654738f7c: To save a second PDF with another layout, change the layout, export again and give it a new name.
b6f55effd7d7: If you see "The app could not print the PDF with its pictures…", turn Pictures off and export again.
8aec4a792c94: On Linux the save window opens in your Downloads folder. If you can't see its buttons, press Enter to save or Esc to cancel.
